question:
**Select the appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.**

Our administration uses _____ techniques to get their work done. They do not rely on__ overt__ tactics.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Covert**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence suggests that the administration uses techniques that are not obvious or **overt**. (स्पष्ट या प्रत्यक्ष)
 
• **Covert **is an antonym of overt, meaning hidden or secret.
 
 
• **Example**: *The spy operated from a covert location, carefully monitoring the target.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, covert is the appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence**: *Our administration uses covert __techniques to get their work done. They do not rely on overt tactics.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Apparent **means obvious or easily seen. (प्रकट)
 
• **Clear **means easy to understand or see. (स्पष्ट)
 
• **Patent **means easily recognizable or obvious. (एकस्व)
